3178.title: Completed reasoning inherits system-log typography
3178.rootCauseOneLine: Completed reasoning is flattened into a generic system operation whose shared detail renderer always uses monospace log typography.
3178.proposedFix: Route the stable internal reasoning operation identity through a prose detail branch while leaving unrelated system details monospace.
3178.caveats: The shared production projection shape and renderer were verified in Ladle; no paid provider turn or packaged desktop window was used.
